Description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious people, deceased people, and environmental pathogens at rates ψ1, ψ3, ψ2 respectively
Infected people entering quarantine at rate ρ3
Shedding of pathogens by infected humans into the environment at rate ρ2
Recovery of quarantined individuals at rate w1

Name: α1
Description: The proportion at which susceptible people are recruited

Name: α2
Description: The proportion at which infected people are recruited

Name: ψ1
Description: The rate of contact (effective) of infected human

Name: ψ2
Description: The rate of contact of Ebola virus pathogens in the environment

Name: ρ1
Description: Rate of deaths of human individuals due to infection

Name: ρ2
Description: Rate at which shedding of infected humans

Name: ρ3
Description: The rate at which infected people quarantined

Name: w1
Description: The rate at which quarantined people are recovered

Name: w2
Description: The rate at which quarantine people are in deceased

Name: h
Description: Proportion of shedding of deceased people

Name: c
Description: The proportion rate of burial deceased people

Name: b
Description: The rate at which EVD in the environment decays

Name: d
Description: Additional input of pathogens into the environment
